name: World of Flavour Menu: Classic Chicken Breast Kiev vs. Indian Prawn Curry
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · World of Flavour Menu (Panama Canal / Long Voyages)
whyItWorks: Baked Chicken Breast Kiev with mashed potatoes is tender and mild, whereas the Indian Prawn Curry carries chili heat and onion/garlic masala.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the Chicken Breast Kiev (let part of the garlic-herb butter run onto the plate if sensitive to garlic) or the Lighter Note Baked Salmon with white rice.
watchOuts: Garlic-herb butter center in Chicken Kiev
Chili spice in Indian Prawn Curry
